newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUAS WIN TOSS, INVITE BOLAND TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUAS WIN TOSS, INVITE BOLAND TO BAT.

text.p: Griqualand West captain Mickey Arthur won the toss and invited Boland to bat first on the opening day of the four-day Supersport Series cricket match at Boland Bank Park on Friday.
Boland - Lloyd Ferreira, Elmar Liebenberg, Matthys Brink, Kenny Jackson, Adrian Kuiper (captain), Andrew Wylie, David Millns, Roger Telemachus, Claude Henderson, Henry Williams, Charl Willoughby.

Griqualand West - Mickey Arthur (captain), Martyn Gidley, Wayne Schonegevel, Pieter Barnard, Craig Light, Finley Brooker, Cedric English, Brett Benkenstein, Wendell Bossinger, Vaughn Walsh, Garth Roe.
